name: id
description: Respondent identifier (1..N), one row per completed brand-perception questionnaire

name: wave
description: Fieldwork wave: wave1 (the first 600 respondents) or wave2 (the next 600), the group field of a multi-group SEM; wave2 carries a planted shift in the value and service means

name: q1
description: Rating 1-5 (poor to excellent): the brand's products are well made. Marker item of the quality factor

name: q2
description: Rating 1-5 (poor to excellent): the brand's products last. Loads on the quality factor

name: q3
description: Rating 1-5 (poor to excellent): the brand's products work as described. Loads on the quality factor

name: v1
description: Rating 1-5 (poor to excellent): the brand is worth what it costs. Marker item of the value factor

name: v2
description: Rating 1-5 (poor to excellent): the brand's prices are fair. Loads on the value factor

name: v3
description: Rating 1-5 (poor to excellent): the brand gives more for the money than rivals. Loads on the value factor

name: s1
description: Rating 1-5 (poor to excellent): the brand's staff are helpful. Marker item of the service factor

name: s2
description: Rating 1-5 (poor to excellent): the brand resolves problems quickly. Loads on the service factor

name: s3
description: Rating 1-5 (poor to excellent): the brand is easy to reach. Loads on the service factor

name: recommend
description: Rating 0-10: how likely the respondent is to recommend the brand to a friend; driven by the quality, value and service factors
